content_data.project_title: NourishNet: Regional Food-Tech Compliance Content Strategy
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive content strategy proposal to establish our food-tech company as a trusted authority in regional food safety and regulatory compliance, enhancing brand credibility and user engagement.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 6 months, with an initial 3-month rollout phase.
objectives: Improve customer understanding of food safety regulations, as measured by post-content survey scores.
Develop and publish 20+ compliance-focused content pieces within the initial 3 months.
Position the company as a key resource for food-tech compliance in the regional market.
Increase organic search traffic to compliance-related content by 30% within 6 months.
deliverables: Script and storyboard for 1-2 short explainer videos on critical food-tech compliance procedures.
Social media content plan for promoting compliance resources.
Detailed content calendar for 6 months, outlining topics, formats, and channels.
Monthly performance reports on content engagement and traffic.
